keep going

Three years ago, I walked off a stage not knowing the best part of my life had already started — introduced by a friend who had no idea what she was starting.

Since then, we've built something out of ordinary Tuesdays and big anniversaries alike. Before the letter, here's a little of what I mean.

A few of my favorite moments

out of a few thousand, honestly

where it started

Right after graduation

A friend introduced us right when I was about to walk off the college stage. A few dates in, and I already knew I wanted more of this.

the one that followed

Our coffee shop

Somewhere between the first date and "together," this became our spot. I still think about how easy it was to just talk to you for hours.

year one

Matching koi

We decided some things deserve to be permanent. So we got matching tattoos — two koi, circling each other, same as us.

year two

Boracay

White sand, that ridiculous sun, and the two of us just having the time of our lives. Easily one of my favorite weeks of my life.

year three

Ocean Park & an overpriced dinner

We spent the day at Ocean Park like kids, then got embarrassingly fancy for dinner after. You looked unfairly good for someone who'd just been at an aquarium all day.

just us, being us

Trips, swimming, pickleball, random weekend adventures, terrible video game teamwork

This is the version of us I love most — no occasion, no plans, just finding something fun to lose at together.

right now

Still my favorite view

Now, the letter

My Grejane,

Three years ago, I was about to walk off a stage and into a completely different chapter of my life — I didn't know that the best part of it had already started, sitting a few tables away, introduced by a friend who had no idea what she was starting.

Since then we've built a whole life out of small, ordinary moments — the ones nobody throws a party for, but I remember all of them. Waking up next to you. Losing terribly at video games together. Getting absolutely destroyed on the pickleball court and blaming the paddle. Swimming until our fingers went wrinkly. Coming home to an apartment that only feels like home because you're in it.

And then the moments we did throw a party for — getting matching ink to mark our first year, because some things deserve to be permanent. Boracay sunsets on our second. And this year, Ocean Park, ridiculous fine dining, and you, more beautiful than any view we saw that day.

Grejane, you are my favorite person to do absolutely nothing with, and my favorite person to do everything with. Thank you for three years of choosing me, again and again, in the small ways and the big ones.

Happy birthday, my love. There's one more thing I have for you — but you're going to have to go find it.

Always yours,
Dabs

One more thing…

There's something physical waiting for you. I'm not just going to tell you — you have to earn it a little.

Somewhere warm, close to where we sleep —
not tucked in blankets, not up on a shelf.
Get on your knees and look down low,
the answer's waiting right under our bed.

(on the floor, right under the bed frame — not between the mattress. love you. go look.)

made with love, for the best three years — here's to many more
